content: The Framework for Collaborative Action on Tuberculosis and Comorbidities is a publication by the World Health Organization (WHO) in 2022. It is available in both electronic and print formats, with respective ISBNs 978-92-4-005505-6 and 978-92-4-005506-3. The publication is distributed under a Creative Commons license, allowing users to copy, redistribute, and adapt the content for non-commercial purposes, provided proper citation is given. However, the use of the WHO logo is prohibited, and any adaptations must be licensed under the same or an equivalent Creative Commons license. If a translation of the work is created, it must include a disclaimer stating that the translation was not produced by WHO and that WHO is not responsible for its content or accuracy. The original English version remains the authoritative edition. The publication includes a suggested citation: Framework for Collaborative Action on Tuberculosis and Comorbidities. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2022. It also provides cataloging-in-publication data and information on sales, rights, and licensing. For third-party materials included in the publication, such as tables, figures, or images, it is the user's responsibility to determine if permission is required for reuse and to obtain such permission from the copyright holder. WHO is not liable for any claims arising from the infringement of third-party-owned components. The designations and presentation of material in the publication do not imply any opinion by WHO regarding the legal status of countries, territories, cities, or areas, nor their authorities or boundaries. Any dotted or dashed lines on maps represent approximate borderlines, which may not yet have full agreement. The mention of specific companies or products does not imply endorsement or recommendation by WHO over others of a similar nature. Proprietary product names are distinguished by initial capital letters. WHO has taken all reasonable precautions to verify the information in the publication, but it is distributed without warranty of any kind. The responsibility for interpretation and use of the material lies with the reader, and WHO is not liable for any damages arising from its use. The framework was developed by Annabel Baddley and Anna Carlqvist, with inputs from Kerri Viney and Farai Mavhunga, under the direction of Tereza Kasaeva, Director of the WHO Global TB Programme. Contributions were made by numerous experts, reviewers, and TB survivors who shared their experiences. The publication acknowledges the efforts of technical consultants, WHO headquarters staff, and regional and country office staff who contributed to its development.
